items.t: Transmission slips or gets stuck in second gear
items.job: Diagnose and update engine/transmission computer software
items.note: If the transmission is worn internally, a rebuild costs much more.

items.t: Misfire and lost power from a dropped valve seat
items.job: Rebuild or replace cylinder head
items.note: 8020 Automotive puts this at $1,000 or more.

items.t: Head gasket failure after overheating
items.job: Replace head gasket(s)

items.t: Coolant leaks and overheating
items.job: Replace water pump, thermostat, hose or radiator
items.note: Shop cost is about $200–$500+ depending on the part.

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil leak
items.job: Replace both valve cover gaskets

items.t: Ticking noise and misfire from stuck lash adjusters
items.job: Replace sticking lash adjuster(s)

items.t: Rough idle and oil leaks from a clogged PCV valve
items.job: Replace PCV valve and change oil

items.t: PCV system can freeze in extreme cold
items.job: Install updated PCV parts

items.t: Shudder or harsh 1-2 and 2-3 shifts
items.job: Transmission fluid service and software update
items.note: A damaged torque converter costs much more.

items.t: Check engine light with code P2181
items.job: Reprogram engine computer

items.t: Clunk or pop from the steering shaft
items.job: Lubricate or replace intermediate steering shaft

items.t: Rear axle pinion nut can loosen and lock the axle
items.job: Rebuild rear differential
items.note: The owner-reported cost was about $2,200. Catching a loose nut early costs far less.

items.t: ABS computer can lock rear brakes (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Mitsubishi dealer

items.t: Static shock can upset lights, signals and wipers (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Mitsubishi dealer

items.t: Manual-transmission truck may start in gear (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Mitsubishi dealer

items.t: Takata driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Mitsubishi dealer

items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Mitsubishi dealer

items.t: Water leak onto the passenger floor
items.job: Reseal cowl and dry carpet

items.t: Water inside headlights or lamps
items.job: Replace leaking headlamp

items.t: Brake pedal shudder at highway speeds
items.job: Replace front rotors and pads

items.t: No crank, no start and no dash lights
items.job: Diagnose and repair front control module or wiring

items.t: Speedometer stops working in cold weather
items.job: Diagnose and repair instrument cluster
